records.issue_text: app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — The public members endpoint accepts an unbounded limit, allowing a viewer to force serialization of an entire large group.
records.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb lines 22-23 that limit is set from params with a default of 50: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i`. There is no maximum cap on this value, so a client can pass an arbitrarily large limit parameter (e.g., limit=1000000) to force the server to serialize and return a massive number of users in a single request.
